changelog:
Initial release of Work Productivity Gog Google Workflow Helper.

- Provides tailored support for Gog-style workflow needs on Clawhub, including bug fixes, setup hardening, reliability improvements, and adjacent workflow creation.
- Follows a structured process: clarifies user need, delivers concise plans or artifacts, and verifies outputs against success criteria.
- Outputs include actionable guides, reusable checklists, and local-hardware-friendly workflows.
- Triggered by common work-productivity and Google Workspace keywords or requests.
- Emphasizes adaptability by making assumptions when possible and structuring responses for immediate usability.
